//==
// # ISurface, solid, and volume interfaces
//
// Continuous two- and three-dimensional geometry as pure functions: a surface
// maps two parameters to a position, a volume maps three (the IProcedural interface
// from `functional.concepts.plato`). Unless a type documents otherwise, a UV
// surface's canonical domain is the unit square and a volume's the unit cube.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surface_(mathematics).

//==
// # Surfaces

// A two-dimensional manifold embedded in 3D space, with or without boundary.
// Marker interface for all surface representations
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surface_(mathematics)).
interface ISurface
    inherits IGeometry3D
